title: Taylor's One Best Way Explained Simply | Principles of Management Ep 8
description:
Is there one best way to do a job? At Chai Corner, six people make chai six different ways, and one cup takes two minutes while another takes five. In this animated lesson we use Ravi's chai stall to understand F.W. Taylor's scientific management, step by step.

You will meet Frederick Winslow Taylor, the father of scientific management, and his 1911 book The Principles of Scientific Management. We watch his famous shovel study at Bethlehem Steel, then run a real time and motion study at Chai Corner: Meena's way against Asha's way, every step timed. We show why standardisation matters, cover Taylor's four principles, and see what standardisation, scientific selection, training, cooperation and functional foremanship look like at work today. We also look at the human side honestly: output went up, but work became dull, workers lost their say, and in 1911 workers at the Watertown Arsenal walked out over the stopwatch.

This is Episode 8 of our Principles of Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.
